name: council
description: Run Codex council reviews by reading SKILL, spawning native reviewers, and enforcing strict inline boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Run strictly bounded Codex reviewer-agent councils
interface.longDescription: Runs focused or broad Codex reviewer-agent councils. Council must read its SKILL and spawn native reviewers; standalone answers are invalid. Inline text is complete unless @path, exact files, or diff is supplied; no memory, repo, git, prior-session, Claude, or local lookup. Broad >6 without approval outputs only: Council not run: broad council approval not granted.
defaultPrompt: Use $council to review this code or plan with best-fit reviewers; inline text is the full target.
Use $council all for a broad engineering and UX review after explicit approval.
Use $council debate to compare hard tradeoffs.
